Tutorials

Install SweepMyTV on your TV and learn how to set it up.

Install SweepMyTV

Using a computer over Wi-Fi? Enable wireless debugging on your TV.

  • Install SweepMyTV from your phone

    Send the installer from Android or iPhone with LocalSend.

  • Install using a USB drive

    Open the APK from a USB drive using your TV’s file manager.

  • Install using your TV browser

    Download the official APK directly if your TV browser supports downloads.

  • Install using Downloader

    Enter the official APK URL in Downloader by AFTVnews.

  • Install from a laptop with ADB

    Connect over your network, pair with a code, or use supported USB debugging.

  • Install with an AI assistant

    Use the setup prompt with Claude Code, Codex, or a chat assistant.

After installing

Ran optional device cleanup? Undo cleanup on your TV.

Open Sweep TV, set up your Home button, and start using Continue Watching.
